channel.title: DigitalShelf Labs
channel.description: Planners, landlord spreadsheets, rental host printables and guides for digital sellers from DigitalShelf Labs.

item.title: Rental Property Spreadsheet for 1–10 Units: Rent, Deposits, Leases and Repairs in One File
item.description: A simple rental property spreadsheet for small landlords with 1–10 long-term units. Log rent as it arrives and the dashboard shows collected vs expected, who owes what, net income per unit, leases ending soon and open repairs. Any currency, no subscription, no bank connection. Standard .xlsx with a sample file. Record-keeping only, not legal or tax advice.

item.title: 2027 Minimal Planner Printable: Calm Year, Month and Week Pages With Nothing Extra
item.description: A calm, uncluttered 2027 planner for seeing your year, month and week at a glance. Clean lines, plenty of writing space and a small soft illustration each month. Includes a year overview, year at a glance, monthly two-page spreads, 53 weekly pages and key dates. Monday or Sunday start, in A4, A5 and US Letter. Prints well at home in colour or black and white.

item.title: Undated Digital Planner: Start Any Day, Any Year, and Never Waste a Page
item.description: Dated planners go blank by February. This undated digital planner has write-in month, week and day fields, so you start whenever you want and skip a week without losing pages. 452-page hyperlinked tablet PDF with 12 monthly, 52 weekly and 364 daily pages, plus habit trackers and notes. Monday-start and Sunday-start versions included. Instant download for PDF annotation apps.
